text:
Priya: hey @eng-platform quick check — i opened a small PR that touches runtime/ and infra/ (link below). runtime owner is OOO today. who can safely approve/merge if it's just a tiny bugfix? https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1478

Devon: if both dirs are listed in CODEOWNERS then technically both teams need to sign off. can you paste the affected files or CODEOWNERS snippet?

Priya: sure — files are runtime/kv_cache.cpp and infra/deploy/ci.yml. CODEOWNERS excerpt:
```
# .github/CODEOWNERS
/runtime/ @runtime-team @liam
/infra/ @eng-infra
```

Maya: liam's on PTO today. for small ops-y infra changes eng-infra usually picks up. runtime tends to be stricter but this looks like a bugfix to kv cache boundary checks — low risk.

Alex: to be safe we can use the eng-platform proxy approval pattern: one reviewer from the affected area + an eng-platform approver if owner unavailable. we should document this more explicitly tho.

infra-bot: label added: needs-approval by @eng-infra

Sam: i can take runtime review quickly. if it's just the boundary guard and tests, i can approve as runtime proxy — i'll leave a comment on the PR saying "approving as runtime proxy per eng-platform fallback, see thread: https://slack.redwood/eng-platform/2678451234"

Priya: awesome, thanks @Sam — i've added your note to the PR and requested your review. also pinging @eng-infra for the infra yaml change.

Devon: fyi if we keep doing these proxy approvals we should add a CODEOWNERS group like @runtime-approvers or update the handbook with the fallback flow (who can proxy, required QA steps).

Maya: +1, opened an issue (internal #567) to track handbook update and a short template for proxy approvals.

Sam: reviewed, tiny test tweak, LGTM. approving now and adding comment that i reviewed as proxy because primary owner is OOO.

Priya: merged — thanks everyone :tada:

Alex: can someone add a one-line note in the PR description next time when expecting proxy approval (reason + owner OOO). helps audits. :eyes:

Priya: will do. thanks again!
